modalities.evidence: Pre-session psychological assessments (PANAS, Psychomotor Vigilance Task)

output.population: A single healthy participant, age 34, scanned repeatedly over 321 days including a venlafaxine taper
output.summary: Dense longitudinal multimodal MRI from one participant scanned mostly self-administered on a clinical 3T scanner across eleven months, spanning a venlafaxine taper, with medication logs, psychological assessments, physiological monitoring and daily lifestyle tracking.
